productDirection.currentRuntime: fixed-camera anime point-and-click horror stage prototype
productDirection.currentGap: Inspection, clue grants, scene completion, transitions, route updates, and save writes mutate state directly without typed result records, stable rejection reasons, command journal, GameHost diagnostics, or DOM-free fixture replay.

runtimeEvidence.readme: README.md describes a fixed-camera anime point-and-click horror prototype using a reusable Stage Kit for locked-camera Three.js diorama scenes, hotspot inspection, story state, procedural stage props, anime shader materials, and WebGL post-processing.
runtimeEvidence.index: index.html mounts #stage, #story-panel, #hotspot-list, #state-debug, #hover-label, #interlude, and loads ./src/game.js as the only module route.
runtimeEvidence.game: src/game.js owns localStorage state, StageKit construction, inspectHotspot, clue grants, log, scene completion, interlude, nextScene, renderUi, and KeyR reset.
runtimeEvidence.stageKit: src/stage-kit.js owns Three.js renderer, scene, camera, raycaster, animated anime materials, post-process shader, hotspot meshes, pointer hover, click picking, resize, and animation.
runtimeEvidence.storyData: src/story-data.js exports three scene descriptors with camera, stage, prop, post, hotspot, clue, completion, and interlude data.
runtimeEvidence.workflow: .github/workflows/deploy.yml deploys the static repository root to GitHub Pages on main pushes.
